title: The Disciplinary Role of Financial Statements: Evidence from Mergers and Acquisitions of Privately Held Targets

issues.description: CODE1 requires SDC-derived ann, acq_u_cusip, dealvalue and TRG_PUBLIC fields plus acquirer/target names and SIC fields. The local SDC.WRDS_MA_DETAILS candidate exposes DATEANN, ACUSIP, APUBLIC, TPUBLIC, ENTVAL and EQVAL; exact mappings, transaction-type fields and period coverage are not established.

CODE1 joins chen.linktable using CUSIP8/CUSIP and reads GVKEY/PERMNO, then sorts and concatenates an unproduced work.permno table. The probed CCMXPF_LINKTABLE candidate has GVKEY/LPERMNO/link dates but lacks the CUSIP and PERMNO fields this join uses.

One-row probes establish local readability/columns for COMP.FUNDA, COMP.FUNDQ, CRSP.DSF and CRSP.DSI, not population or date coverage. CODE1 needs pre_year through ann_year; CODE2 needs eff-year −3..−1 and +1..+3, a 1990–2012 full-population industry input, and daily observations inside the eventdate−200 to −60 calendar-day bounds (the executable INTNX statements use the Day interval); CODE3 needs quarterly match history plus prior 12 and forward 36 monthly returns and date-specific breakpoint populations. Required sample coverage is unverified.

CODE2 creates market-model data as ret2, then joins beta from a separate dataset named ret at line 191. No producer for work.ret appears in the supplied programs; intended table name and contents are unspecified.

CODE2 constructs threshold at line 68, while three outcome branches and CODE3’s BHAR branch call the winsor macro on threshold1. The intended column is unspecified; do not assume threshold1 means threshold.

CODE2 reads chen.crsp_day_cal_2013 and main.crsp_day_cal_2013_prdt, but no MAIN libref is assigned. CODE3 separately reads two calendars under its Data libref; comments refer to 2010 while executable names use 2013. Calendar producers, mappings, directory relationships and coverage remain unspecified.

CODE2 imports Sample/data.xlsx into WORK.DATA; CODE3 later reads Data/chen.data.sas7bdat. No supplied producer connects these distinct paths/directories, and the shared key/field/type mapping, including ann versus eff, is undocumented.

CODE3 requires a prebuilt quarterly Compustat–CRSP comp_match table with fyearq, gvkey, lpermno, datadate, ceqq and sic, but supplies no producer, inclusion/link rules or history contract. The catalogued CCM linktable is not this merged dataset.
CODE3 reads m_crsp with exchcd. The local CRSP.MSF candidate exposes hexcd, not exchcd, and does not establish that author m_crsp exchange-code semantics or required 12/36-month history match.

Conditional lead beyond the supplied outcome-builder target: Appendix Table OA1 reports final disclosure-performance regressions, but CODE1–CODE3 provide sample/outcome construction and a market-model PROC REG, not the final table driver. If reproducing OA1 is intended, the final regression code and the exact STOCK_DEAL constructor (including mixed stock/cash treatment) need to be identified; this audit does not add those as mandatory builder inputs.

The datasheet says FIRM ID lists CIKs for the final sample, but bounded inspection shows a gvkey header. It is an identifier list, not a filing-ready CIK crosswalk or analysis panel; create and validate the needed acquirer CIK crosswalk via public SEC company lookup.

actions.description: For a future authorized batch run, map the known Windows Sample and Data roots and both literal XLSX paths to distinct relative execution roots under the assigned runtime working directory. Keep the unresolved MAIN prior-calendar location separate.
steps: Set the SAS host wrapper working directory to the assigned runtime work directory before batch launch. Use distinct relative roots `execution/Sample` for CODE1/CODE2 and `execution/Data` for CODE3; create the two subdirectories there if needed.
Map CODE1 `libname chen` (line 14) and `sample_all.xlsx` (line 18) under `execution/Sample`, with workbook path `execution/Sample/sample_all.xlsx` relative to the runtime working directory.
Map CODE2 `libname chen` (line 17) and `data.xlsx` import (line 22) under the same `execution/Sample`, with workbook path `execution/Sample/data.xlsx` relative to the runtime working directory.

Map CODE3 `libname chen` (line 12) under distinct `execution/Data` so its referenced `comp_match.sas7bdat`, `m_crsp.sas7bdat`, `data.sas7bdat`, `crsp_day_cal_2013_prdt.sas7bdat` and `crsp_day_cal_2013.sas7bdat` use that Data root. Root mapping does not establish these files are present or produced.
Keep CODE2 `main.crsp_day_cal_2013_prdt` unresolved and separate; do not alias it to Sample or Data until its actual location is identified.
Keep the Sample/Data distinction and the Code2-to-Code3 handoff issue; path localization alone does not supply a producer or convert data.xlsx into Data/chen.data.
validation: Before batch launch, verify the wrapper current working directory is the assigned runtime work directory and that it is writable.
Resolve CODE1/CODE2 libname and import locations relative to that directory under the same Sample root; verify literal workbook filenames.
Resolve CODE3 data-library references relative to that directory under the separate Data root and verify required prebuilt inputs are supplied at the documented names.
Confirm Sample and Data roots are distinct and writable; validate the MAIN calendar independently after its actual path is specified.

review_notes: The supplied FIRM ID.txt is a bounded single-column GVKEY list rather than an analysis dataset or the CIK list described in the datasheet; no analysis_only scope is supported.
The public SEC manual route is available for the described CIK/form/date workflow. The required hand-coding remains a preparation task; no author snapshot identity or author-approval gate is imposed.

CODE2 writes under its Sample libref while CODE3 reassigns chen to the Data directory. CODE3 also consumes the CODE2 WORK.controls table and winsor macro, so the supplied programs require the stated same-session order and separately resolved Data inputs.

All 20 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed individually. Local one-row probes support source readability/column availability only; source-specific history, population, constructor and field-alias gaps remain explicit.
No author SAS program or regression was run. No original author package files were edited; execution_verified remains false.
Appendix Table OA1 and STOCK_DEAL are retained as a conditional lead for a paper-table extension, not as mandatory external inputs to the supplied CODE1–CODE3 outcome-builder target.
CODE2’s executable INTNX("Day") statements set calendar-day market-model bounds −200 and −60; CRSP daily rows are joined inside those bounds.

Added a supported future batch configuration using relative execution/Sample and execution/Data roots from the assigned runtime working directory; no mapping was applied and the MAIN prior-calendar location remains unresolved.
